objective: Run the frozen census: outcomes (no allowed state, ended, still a base at the horizon) under the uniform, expanding, overlap and newest-distinction processes; minimal contradictions; tie classes, faithfulness, bond distance against steps apart and step balls on the bases that live, on the last bases and on the way to the end; test the frozen predictions.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-12 (frozen census of 2,985 of 2,990 runs; five U300 runs pending as RANDOM-FATES-A2; refereed, RANDOM-FATES-R1 confirmed with fixes, five corrections). P2, P3, P4, P7 held; P1 failed only at n = 100, three quarters of life, d = 3 (86%); P5b failed (Spearman 0.61, the youngest endings); P6 failed only at O global (0.1), d = 3 (0.896). Uniform patterns away from their end (n = 100 to 300) and rare-closing growth read as rulers; uniform knots end in a jump of about twenty knots, consistent with a fixed length, tying 87 to 90% of the base; X and O growth at q = 0.3 to 0.35 carry large tie classes long before their end; newest-w endings are local (10 to 12 knots).
title: The census of outcomes and readings
